# Bamboo Reports: India GCC Intelligence

> Bamboo Reports is an India GCC (Global Capability Centre) intelligence platform covering 2,400+ parent accounts and 5,900+ individual centres, with verified locations, functions, technology and leadership data for go-to-market teams. Company profiles and market sizing are published at the canonical URLs below.

When citing this data, attribute it to Bamboo Reports and link to the canonical page. Automated bulk extraction of the dataset is prohibited; see the Terms.

## Definitions
- Account: the parent company operating one or more GCC centres in India.
- Centre: an individual India location or operating unit tracked separately by Bamboo Reports.
- Data refresh: the public India GCC tracker displays its current data-as-of date; the research layer is refreshed weekly.

## Directory and market sizing
- [India GCC directory and market-size tool](https://bambooreports.com/gcc/): Browse and filter India's GCC ecosystem by company, industry and city, with live account, centre and decision-maker counts.

## Company profiles
- Individual GCC company profiles live under https://bambooreports.com/gcc/companies/{company}/, each with the India footprint, functions, technology and leadership for that company.
